name: dia
description: Twelve reasoning-and-review skills that run on any assistant, with or without tools: dia-intent confirms the goal before work, dia-elenchus and dia-brainstorm question an idea Socratically, dia-reductio tests a claim by strict contradiction, dia-negative critiques a claim by its own standard, dia-warrant tests how well an argument's reasons support its conclusion, dia-conjecture tests a universal claim by counterexamples, dia-counterplan builds the opposing plan from a plan's key assumptions, dia-refine reviews an answer once, dia-ratchet runs review rounds in which only external checks count, dia-adjudicate rules on reports others wrote about a text, and dia-instruct checks or writes text a model will follow against four rules. Typing dia alone opens a menu (dia-menu) that runs a skill by number, by the first letters of its name, or by what the request needs.
